question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. INCESSANT
solution:
The correct answer is: **Continuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Incessant"** means something that is unending, uninterrupted, or occurring without pause. (अविरत)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The incessant noise from the construction site made it impossible to concentrate.
 
 
 
• **"Continuous"** refers to something that goes on without any break or pause, similar in meaning to "incessant." (निरंतर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The continuous rainfall caused flooding in several areas.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'incessant'** is **'continuous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Continuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frequent** (बार-बार): Occurring often or at regular intervals.
 
 
 
• **Example:** She makes frequent visits to her grandparents on weekends.
 
 
 
 
• **Recurring** (पुनरावर्ती): Happening repeatedly or at regular intervals.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The recurring theme of forgiveness was central to the story.
 
 
 
 
• **Repetitive** (दोहराव): Involving the same actions or words repeated over and over again.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The repetitive nature of the task made it tiresome for the workers.
